limits: Browser tests use isolated fixtures with owner/editor roles and intercepted network requests; no production business data was changed.
WebKit 26.0 and Chromium 141 were run, not a physical iPhone keyboard or microphone.
A reduced viewport checks visible results and retained search focus; it does not emulate the native keyboard.
The pre-build overlapping browser invocation is excluded. Only the complete frozen-source run is counted.
Passing these tests validates their assertions and does not establish that the whole application is free of defects.
